rainfall: Precipitation reaching the surface, reported as daily depth rate or monthly total after checking source units.
aod: Aerosol Optical Depth at 550 nm describes light extinction by particles through the atmospheric column. It is dimensionless.
aod_surface_warning: AOD does not directly measure ground-level PM2.5.
region_warning: This selection is a rectangular analysis box rather than an exact administrative boundary.
missing: No valid observation is available for this time. Missing values are not zero.
coverage: Monthly temporal coverage is the proportion of calendar days with a valid regional daily value, when available. Spatial coverage is a separate quantity.
anomaly: An unusual value relative to the same calendar month in the stated baseline. A flag is descriptive and depends on coverage and method.
heavy_rain_share: Percentage of wet-day rainfall contributed by days above the baseline wet-day 95th percentile. This is a project adaptation of climate-index concepts.
dry_spell: Longest observed run of regional-mean rainfall below 1 mm/day within the selected year or season. Missing days interrupt the run.
regional_indicator_warning: Regional averaging smooths local extremes. These indicators do not describe every location inside the box.
interaction_warning: Associations do not establish causality. MODIS clear-sky retrievals under-sample cloudy and rainy conditions.
evidence_warning: Evidence labels follow a documented team convention, not an official NASA confidence score.
